sloka: बाष्प अम्बु प्रतिपूर्णेन कृष्ण वक्त्र अक्षि पक्ष्मणा ।वदनेन अप्रसन्नेन निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ॥५-१५-३६॥
transliteration: bāṣpa ambu pratipūrṇena kṛṣṇa vaktra akṣi pakṣmaṇā ।vadanena aprasannena nihśvasantīm punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-15-36॥

translations.english: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.
